svg.title: Who the ATM Operator Negotiates With
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-06-atm-location-deal-map; chapter number: 11; title: Who the ATM Operator Negotiates With; subtitle: The counterparties behind every signed location; chart type: org_architecture; center: role: ATM route operator; headcount: Operators running five machines to 100-plus; focus: Signed location agreements and surcharge pricing near the $3 norm; spokes: role: Location owner; type: Surcharge split partner; kpi: Chad Otsuji held $2 of a $3 surcharge and gave the owner $1; role: Real decision maker; type: Agreement signer; kpi: Breach clause bills $4,800 plus a $100 fee on 24 months left; role: Incumbent operator; type: Buyout counterparty; kpi: Austin Zaback pays five to ten grand for them to walk; role: Cash loader; type: Vault cash partner; kpi: Five self-loaded machines tied up $112,500 for almost 2 years; caption: Philip Webb's rule holds across every spoke: no signed location agreement, no machine.; assumptions note: Split, buyout, and breach figures come from different operators and different sites; terms ranged from one-year caps to five-year auto-renewals.; note: Sources include Philip Webb, Chad Otsuji ATM Business, and Austin Zaback.
